method: Exact saved handoff self-read against receipt, source capsule and live log
score_reason: Direct state, outcome and resume commands; little generic wording.
confidence_reason: Short technical handoff self-assessed without an independent human reader.

examples.cue: Names carried-over state and exact branch
examples.impact: The parent can distinguish a green test from a landed change.
examples.quote: landing and aggregate acceptance remain inconclusive

examples.cue: Claims one measured case and its limits
examples.impact: Prevents a one-fixture result from becoming a broad or calibration claim.
examples.quote: successful bootstrap refit count and coverage calibration were not established

science_gate_reason: The one-case scope, approximation-specific checks and interval limitations match the raw receipt.
facts_gate_reason: Branch, elapsed time, expectation count, source capsule and log hashes match saved local evidence.
references_gate_reason: No external source or bibliographic claim is used.
calibration_status: No benchmark controls were used; score is an editorial self-judgment only.
